subject: Mock audit: scheduling & evidence bundle request — HelixBank pilot
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@firstpoint.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Mock audit: scheduling & evidence bundle request — HelixBank pilot

Elaine,

Thanks again for agreeing to run a short mock audit for HelixBank's security team to help validate our evidence packaging and sample extraction before the formal FedRAMP/ISO intake. Proposed items:

- Window: July 13–15 (two half-day sessions) — can accommodate region/timezone constraints.
- Scope: controls mapped to SOC 2 + ISO 27001 baseline; we'll surface CAIQ / SIG responses during the session.
- Deliverables we will prepare in advance (bundled): access logs (30-day sample), KMS key rotation record, SOC2 Type II summary, CAIQ snapshot, incident response playbook excerpt.

Attached: mock-audit-template.xlsx (evidence index) and evidence-index.md (readme for pack format).

Questions for you (so we can pre-package correctly):
1) Preferred sampling size for log exports (e.g., 7 vs 30 days) for HelixBank's reviewers?
2) Do reviewers want live console demos (OKTA, cloud logs) or only exported artifacts?
3) Any specific control owners you want cc'd or who should be prepared to speak?

Can you confirm HelixBank's availability and whether you need any pre-authenticated links or read-only accounts? Jordan from HelixBank is onboarded on our side — cc'd separately.

Regards,

Rafael Mendes
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: mock-audit-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[attachment: evidence-index.md (markdown)]

From: Elaine Park <elaine@firstpoint.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan@helixbank.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mock audit: scheduling & evidence bundle request — HelixBank pilot

Rafael —

Appreciate the outline. July 13–15 works on our side; we prefer two 3-hour sessions (morning PT) so reviewers have time to dig in between sessions.

To your questions:
1) 30-day log exports are ideal for a first pass; if that's heavy we can accept a targeted 7-day + representative event list.
2) Live demos are useful for access control flows (OKTA/SCIM) but we will need read-only accounts. For cloud logs, exports are fine — include a short README describing log format and parsing instructions.
3) Please have explicit control owners for: identity & access (IAM/OKTA), key management (KMS), and incident response. We'll want those people on the call or available asynchronously.

We typically accept artifacts as a single zipped evidence bundle plus a short index (CSV/Excel). If you can deliver the bundle by July 7 we'll run an internal pre-screen.

Quick ask: can you also populate the CAIQ spreadsheet with your current answers? That saves time during the mock. I'm attaching our standard mock-audit-checklist for reference.

Thanks,

Elaine Park
Lead Audit Consultant
FirstPoint Security
[attachment: mock-audit-checklist.pdf (PDF)]
